english.title: Trespass on transport systems in Bristol
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), trespassed on

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) which was not situated in a street but was on part of the transport systems which were subject to the Ashton Vale to Temple Meads and Bristol City Centre Rapid Transit Order 2013]_
(B)_[land of the promoter, namely **(..SPECIFY LAND..), which was in dangerous proximity to transport systems that were subject to the Ashton Vale to Temple Meads and Bristol City Centre Rapid Transit Order 2013, or to electrical or other apparatus used for or in connection with the operation of those transport systems]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 42 of the Ashton Vale to Temple Meads and Bristol City Centre Rapid Transit Order 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
trespassed on any
part of a transport system not situated in a street OR
land of the promoter in dangerous proximity to the transport system OR
apparatus used for or in connection with the operation of transport systems

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: No person is to be convicted of this offence unless it is shown that a notice warning the public not to trespass upon the transport systems was clearly exhibited and maintained at the stop on the transport systems nearest the place where the offence is alleged to have been committed.
